title: Fortune
slip.initial: Crack open a cookie for a little wisdom…
kept.title: Kept fortunes
foot: Fortunes come from adviceslip.com over the internet — tap the “Internet” button up top to see or change that. This app never invents a line.
err.nogifos: Open this from GifOS to reach the internet. This app will not invent a fortune.
err.denied: Internet is off for this app. Tap “Internet” in the top bar to allow adviceslip.com. This app will not invent a fortune.
err.timeout: adviceslip.com took too long. Try again when you have a better connection.
err.empty: That reply had no advice in it. Try another cookie.
err.generic: Couldn’t reach adviceslip.com. You may be offline. This app will not make a fortune up.
